title: Create K-line data API endpoint
description: Create FastAPI router endpoint GET /api/v1/kline/{code} that accepts period (daily/weekly/monthly), start_date, end_date, limit query parameters. Calls KlineService.get_kline_data() and returns KlineDataResponse. Follow existing endpoint patterns from strategy_backtest.py.

files.change: FastAPI router with GET /kline/{code} endpoint, query params for period/start/end/limit

implementation: Define GET /{code} endpoint with Path param code:str, Query params period:str='daily', start_date:Optional[str], end_date:Optional[str], limit:int=500(ge=1,le=2000)
Instantiate KlineService(db_manager), call get_kline_data() with parsed parameters
Handle ValueError for invalid params (400) and generic Exception (500) following strategy_backtest.py error pattern
Return KlineDataResponse constructed from service output dict

reference.pattern: FastAPI router with dependency injection, error handling via HTTPException
reference.examples: Follow run_strategy_backtest() pattern: try/except with ValueError->400, Exception->500, use Depends(get_database_manager)

criteria: Endpoint responds to GET /api/v1/kline/{code} with period/start_date/end_date/limit query params
Returns 200 with KlineDataResponse JSON containing bars[] and indicators[]
Returns 400 for invalid period value or date format
Returns 500 with error detail for service failures
Swagger docs show endpoint with correct parameter descriptions
